tools.description: Explain one finding or error code: summary, severity, whether it blocks, when it is emitted, remediation steps and a before/after example. Call it for any code you do not recognize (fit and pattern codes, chart.*, SEMANTIC_*, input / template / render errors). An unknown code returns the closest known one.
tools.name: describe_finding

tools.description: Examine a PPTX template and return its capability report inline (writes no files): theme fonts and colours, canonical layout coverage (title-slide, section-divider, one-content, qa-closing), derivable layouts, each layout's placeholders with capacities, the grid, and findings such as TPL.LAYOUT.MISSING_ROLE. Use it before authoring on a user-provided template. Supply EXACTLY ONE of template_name or template_path.

base_dir.description: Absolute directory template_path resolves against and must stay inside. Default: the server CWD.

strict.description: true: metadata warnings fail validation too.

template_name.description: Registered template name. This OR template_path.

template_path.description: Local .pptx, resolved against base_dir (else the server CWD) and required to stay inside it. This OR template_name.

tools.name: examine_template

tools.description:
The recommended workflow for a task, written for the tools this server lists. Call it first.

Default for content-bearing decks: author real content as a DeckSpec; `list_slide_kinds` → `validate_deck_spec` → `render_deck_spec`, then render and inspect every slide: a passing gate is never completion.

This tools/list is abridged: tool:"<name>" returns that tool's full description and input schema.

skill_version.description: schema_version of the installed generate-deck skill; an older one returns skill_warning with the refresh command.

task.description: brief (default, a new deck) | revise (deck_id + patch) | validate-only | onboard-template (vet a user-supplied .pptx).

tool.description: A tool name: return tool_detail (its full description and input schema) instead of a workflow.

verbose.description: true: include quality_workflow, the initialize instructions repeated.

tools.name: get_started

tools.description: Discover DeckSpec slide kinds. Without arguments: one line per kind (what it is for, required_fields). kinds:[…]: each named kind's full summary, typical fields and copy-ready example. fields selects detail instead: brief (one-line field signatures with text budgets), item_schema (fields with descriptions and aliases), budgets (per-field text budgets, measured on template), compositions (pattern / layout overrides), example, item_schema_full (closed JSON Schema). kinds:["raw_json2pptx"] also returns a composed example (several views under one title).

kinds.description: Exact kind names to return, e.g. ["kpi_snapshot"]. Omit for all.

preview.description: true: also return an image of each named kind's example (1-4 kinds), rendered on template.

template.description: Template name; adds budgets measured on it.

tools.name: list_slide_kinds

tools.description: List presentation templates. fields="names": one small row per template (name, aspect ratio, layout count, fonts, primary fill), enough to pick one. The default (compact) adds table styles, canonical layout IDs, colour roles (contrast-safe accents, the ink each accent carries) and body font sizes; fields="full" adds theme colours, grid, layout summaries with placeholders and the supported chart / diagram types. Paginated: cursor + page_size, next_cursor when more remain.

base_dir.description: Absolute directory template_path resolves against and must stay inside.

filter.description: Case-insensitive substring of the template name.

read_only.description: true: write no layout-preview PNGs to the cache.

template_path.description: One local .pptx the server has not registered; must stay inside base_dir (else the server CWD). Not with template.

tools.name: list_templates

tools.description: Plan a deck from a brief: an ordered slide outline with a narrative role, layout, pattern and content seeds per slide. format:"deckspec" (recommended) returns deck_spec, a DeckSpec draft whose kinds follow the brief, plus slots[] (path, guidance, facts): fill it using list_slide_kinds, then validate_deck_spec → render_deck_spec. A brief that lists its slides gets one slide per item, in order; deck instructions ("8 slides", "with an agenda") return as constraints[]; every other clause is routed to a slide or listed in unplaced_facts. With format "raw", slides[] are advisory records, not slide inputs.

audience.description: Target audience, e.g. "board of directors"; influences pattern choice.

brief.description: What the deck is for and what it must say, in natural language.

format.description: "deckspec": a DeckSpec draft for validate_deck_spec / render_deck_spec. "raw" (default): a pattern outline with raw slide skeletons.

must_include.description: Pattern names the plan must use, e.g. ["kpi-3up"].

slide_budget.description: Target slide count (3-30). Default: the count the brief states, else 10.

template.description: Template name: each slide then carries template_support, and a pattern the template cannot host is replaced.

tools.name: plan_deck

tools.description: Rank visuals for a slide intent across layouts, named patterns, charts, diagrams, raw shape_grid and the regions kind. Every candidate carries data_contract (keys, limits) and a runnable next_tool_call (render_deck_spec with a complete DeckSpec: the kind that compiles to it, else a raw_json2pptx slide); also_as names other forms of the same visual, differs_by what separates near ties. Compose candidates put several views on one slide. A visual with no renderer (Sankey) returns unsupported_visual. With candidates, ONLY those names are scored and all are returned.

candidates.description: Shortlist to rank instead: layout, pattern, chart or diagram names, raw_shape_grid, or a compose:<a>+<b> name this tool returned.

intent.description: What the slide should show, e.g. "compare 3 vendors on 5 dimensions".

prefer_variety.description: true: penalize patterns named in recent_patterns.

preview.description: true: also return an image of each leading candidate (max 4).

recent_patterns.description: Pattern names on the preceding slides, in order.

slide_index.description: 0-based index of the slide being built.

template.description: Template name: candidates carry template_support and ones it cannot host are demoted; previews render on it.

tools.name: recommend_visual

tools.description: Compile a DeckSpec and render it to a .pptx: the one-call path for a NEW deck. Returns pptx_path, deck_id, diagnostics[] (validate_deck_spec's findings, at JSON Pointer paths), deterministic_ready, publishable and blocking_reasons[]. success means the file was WRITTEN; deterministic_ready means no blocking diagnostic remains; publishable also needs an approved all-slide visual verdict and is false on a fresh render: render every slide with render_deck_thumbnails, inspect the images, then record the verdict with submit_visual_review. quality_summary is an input heuristic, not a visual verdict.

base_dir.description: Absolute directory that relative asset paths in the spec and template_path resolve against and must stay inside. Default: the deck_id's last render root, else the server CWD.

deck_id.description: Handle a validate_deck_spec or render_deck_spec response returned, sent INSTEAD of spec; add patch to edit. The stored spec after patches: validate_deck_spec {deck_id, read:"spec"}. Per-process, expires after 1 hour: then send the spec again.

fork.description: true: store the result under a NEW deck_id; this one stays as it is.

output_filename.description: Name of the .pptx inside the server's output directory. Default: derived from meta.title and a digest of the spec.

output_validation.description: Post-generation output validation (default strict: refuses to emit a deck with text overflow).

patch.description: Edits to deck_id's spec, applied first: [{op, path, value | from}]. path is a JSON Pointer; a slide is named by index or id (/slides/3/title, /slides/s4/title); add at /slides/6 inserts, "-" appends. All ops apply or none; the response lists changed_slides.

restore.description: Revision of deck_id to start from; patch applies on top.

spec.description: The DeckSpec to render: a JSON object ({meta:{title, template}, slides:[{kind, …}]}) or a YAML/JSON string. Send this OR deck_id; sent again with the same title, template and slide ids it is the next revision of its deck_id.

strict.description: Advisory-rule strictness: off, warn (default), or strict.

template.description: Template for this call; overrides meta.template. list_templates lists names.

template_path.description: Local .pptx to render with; must stay inside base_dir. Not with template. Check it with examine_template first.

verbose.description: true: full summaries on a patch render (default: changed slides only).

tools.name: render_deck_spec

tools.description: Render a PPTX's slides as MCP image blocks (one JPEG per slide, in order) you can look at, plus slides[].index, path (the PNG submit_visual_review verifies) and content_hash. Needs LibreOffice and ImageMagick. 15 slides are ~600KB at density 50; after a repair, pass only render_deck_spec's changed_slides as slide_indices.

force.description: true: bypass the render cache and re-convert.

include_base64_json.description: Legacy: base64 in the JSON instead of image blocks.

known_hashes.description: content_hash values you already hold: those slides return unchanged:true and no image.

max_slides.description: First N slides (default 50). Not with slide_indices.

pptx_path.description: Path to the PPTX to render: render_deck_spec returns pptx_path.

slide_indices.description: ONLY these slides, by 0-based index or slide id, e.g. [4, "costs"]. Not with max_slides.

tools.name: render_deck_thumbnails

tools.description: Score a deck's STRUCTURAL quality with deterministic rules: overall_score (0-100, basis="structural"), per-slide scores and findings with fix suggestions. It generates the deck into a temporary directory and scores the generated structure; it never looks at rendered pixels, so it cannot visually approve a deck (use render_deck_thumbnails and look). Send a DeckSpec deck_id, or a raw presentation.

allow_degraded_scoring.description: true: score on static analysis when the render pass fails. Default: a render failure is a blocking RENDER_EVIDENCE_INCOMPLETE finding.

base_dir.description: Absolute directory relative asset paths (images, backgrounds, icons) resolve against. Default: the server CWD.

deck_id.description: Stored deck handle from validate_deck_spec / render_deck_spec. This OR presentation.

presentation.description: A raw json2pptx presentation ({template, slides[]}). Not a DeckSpec: send its deck_id instead.

slide_indices.description: 0-based slides to score; the rest are skipped.

template.description: Template override. Default: the presentation's own.

tools.name: score_deck

tools.description: Show full details for a named pattern, including its authoritative JSON Schema for values, overrides, and cell_overrides.
tools.name: show_pattern

tools.description: Record the visual review verdict for a rendered PPTX: the completion step once you (or a human) have inspected the rendered slides. slides[] must cover EVERY slide exactly once, each with the image render_deck_thumbnails returned for it (path or content_hash); partial coverage, a stale pptx_revision or any other image is rejected and nothing is recorded. status is "visually_reviewed_current_revision" only when every slide is approved with no P0/P1 finding and the render's deterministic gate passed.

pptx_path.description: Path to the reviewed PPTX file.

pptx_revision.description: sha256 (content_hash) of the reviewed PPTX, as the render returned it.

reviewer.description: Who reviewed: "host" (default, the calling agent) or "manual" (a human).

revision.description: Optional render_deck_spec revision; must match the deck's authoring manifest.

slides.description: One entry per slide, each with the image you inspected.

severity.description: P0 unreadable or broken, P1 major, P2 minor, P3 nitpick. P0/P1 block approval.

image_path.description: The PNG you inspected (render_deck_thumbnails slides[].path), or give image_sha256.

image_sha256.description: Its pixel hash (slides[].content_hash), instead of image_path.

tools.name: submit_visual_review

tools.description: Validate a DeckSpec by running its render into a scratch directory: the same findings render_deck_spec reports for that spec and template. template echoes the template measured on. A finding blocks only when severity is error (blocking:true); ok=false means one does. patch_verified:true: the finding's next_tool_call patch was tried and clears it. Also reads a stored deck (read, find).

base_dir.description: Root for relative asset paths, as on render_deck_spec.

deck_id.description: Stored spec handle, sent INSTEAD of spec; see render_deck_spec.

find.description: Text or number to locate anywhere in the spec; alone it returns hits[{path, slide_id, index, excerpt}] instead of validating.

patch.description: Edits to deck_id's spec, applied before the call acts and stored when the result parses; see render_deck_spec.

read.description: Return the stored deck instead of validating: "spec", "history" (revisions and each slide's last change), "diff:2..5" (changes between two revisions), or a slide id / index.

replace.description: With find: rewrite every hit as one stored patch, then validate.

spec.description: The DeckSpec to validate: a JSON object ({meta:{title, template, …}, slides:[{kind, …}]}; structure:{sections[]} instead of slides generates agenda and dividers) or a YAML/JSON string. Send this OR deck_id. list_slide_kinds lists the kinds (kinds:[chosen] returns examples, fields:[brief] or [item_schema] a kind's fields); get_started tool:"validate_deck_spec" returns the meta and structure outline. Unknown fields report SEMANTIC_UNKNOWN_FIELD.

strict.description: Advisory-rule strictness (default warn): whether rhythm/density advisories are info, warnings, or errors.

template.description: Template to measure on; overrides meta.template for this call.

templates.description: Also measure on these, or ["all"]: template_results[{template, ok, summary, findings}].

tools.name: validate_deck_spec
